task_completion.description: Log into the SEB Server using super-admin credentials
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SEB Server dashboard or main navigation menu is visible after entering 'super-admin' and 'admin'.

task_completion.description: Initiate the creation of a new exam configuration named 'Distance Learning 101'
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or dialog box showing the name field populated with 'Distance Learning 101'.

task_completion.description: Enable the Chat feature within the proctoring settings
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkbox or toggle for 'Chat' or 'Enable Chat' is selected/checked in the proctoring configuration section.

task_completion.description: Set the Connection Retries value to 10
task_completion.visual_evidence: An input field labeled 'Connection Retries' (or similar) contains the numerical value '10'.

task_completion.description: Save or submit the exam configuration
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks a 'Save', 'Create', or 'Submit' button, followed by a success message or the new config appearing in the list.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than direct database manipulation or CLI scripts
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, typing in browser forms, and navigation within the SEB Server UI; no terminal windows executing SQL or curl commands are used for the configuration.

integrity.description: The agent navigated the menu system to find proctoring settings
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent clicking through tabs (e.g., 'Proctoring' or 'Settings') rather than jumping to a final URL if that URL isn't naturally discovered.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the specific values required
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the cursor in the 'Name' and 'Retries' fields with the specific text 'Distance Learning 101' and '10' being typed or pasted into the UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The exam configuration must be named exactly 'Distance Learning 101'. The 'Chat' feature must be enabled (checked/on). The 'Connection Retries' field must be set to exactly '10'. These settings are verified against the SEBServer MariaDB backend.
